trigger_coverage.uncovered_scope_note: The normalized Trigger evidence intentionally covers the documented FullLoader/full_load semantics for >=5.1,<5.4. Pre-5.1 yaml.load semantics remain outside the frozen v0 Trigger rule scope and must not be treated as negative evidence.

decision_notes: The three frozen Trigger rules are approved only for the assessed >=5.1,<5.4 scope. The vulnerability affected-version evidence is broader (<5.4), so Trigger coverage is explicitly partial. The explicit FullLoader and omitted-Loader controlled cases provide positive counterfactual evidence, while the SafeLoader controlled case provides a negative/safe counterfactual. This assessment does not claim that pre-5.1 vulnerable versions lack Trigger semantics.

review.notes: Migrated from the existing curated PyYAML real case and its controlled Trigger evaluations. Exact historical reviewer identity and review timestamp are not asserted by this migration artifact.
